overview.heading: What is BHMS?
paragraphs: BHMS stands for Bachelor of Homeopathic Medicine and Surgery. It is a 5.5-year undergraduate course in India, usually with 4.5 years of classroom and clinical study plus a 1-year internship. Students study biology, medical basics, homeopathic principles, and how to speak with patients and record symptoms carefully.

The course is for students who want to work in homeopathic healthcare rather than general medicine. Entry is usually after Class 12 Science with Physics, Chemistry and Biology, and admission is commonly through NEET. The learning style is steady and detailed, with a strong focus on theory, practice, and patient interaction.

After BHMS, many graduates work in clinics, hospitals, teaching, counselling, or related healthcare roles. To practise as a homeopathic doctor, a graduate usually needs the recognised degree, internship completion, and state registration before independent practice. It suits students who are patient, interested in biology, and comfortable with a medical path that builds slowly through study and experience.

snapshot.data_note: Pay in this field varies widely by city, type of workplace, years of experience, and whether the doctor works in a clinic, hospital, consultancy role, or private practice. New graduates often start lower, while established practitioners can earn more after building patient trust and experience.

salary.note: India-wide published salary ranges for homeopathic doctors commonly span about INR 60,000 to INR 7,50,000 a year, with an average around INR 3,70,000. Private practice, location, experience, and additional responsibilities can move earnings up or down.

caution.heading: Be careful about these common misunderstandings
points: BHMS is not the same as MBBS, and it prepares a student for homeopathic practice rather than allopathic medicine.
Graduation alone does not mean immediate independent practice; internship and the required registration step matter before working as a home
Earnings are not fixed, and many early roles pay modestly until a doctor gains experience or builds a practice.
The course suits students who can handle long hours of study and patient interaction, not only textbook learning.

curriculum.assessment_methods: Written university examinations, practical and viva voce examinations, clinical case presentation, internal assessment, hospital or dispensary postings, and internship performance evaluation.
curriculum.learning_activities: Lectures, anatomy and laboratory sessions, bedside and outpatient clinical observation, case taking, repertorisation practice, pharmacy work, community medicine postings, seminars, tutorials, and internship-based patient care.

parent_corner.intro: BHMS suits students who are comfortable with biology, patient interaction, and steady reading. It is an undergraduate medical course in homeopathy, so families should look at the whole pathway, not only the degree title. The course is commonly 5.5 years long, with a long clinical and internship phase that matters as much as classroom study. Admission usually depends on the national entrance route used for undergraduate medical courses, so performance in Class 11-12 is important. After the degree, graduates still need the correct professional registration before practising independently. When comparing colleges, check recognition, internship arrangements, distance from home, and the full cost of the programme, including hostel and other charges.
